description: Two-byte magic 0xA65C, a big-endian payload length that counts only the payload, a request id, a flags byte and a command byte; the fixed header is 8 bytes. Wrong variant: the length is read as if it counted the header, which the corpus contradicts.

fields.name: magic
fields.description: Constant 0xA65C on every message; a strong boundary signal.

fields.name: payload_length
fields.description: Bytes of payload after the 8-byte header.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Increments across a session; echoed so pairs can be correlated.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Observed values 0x00/0x01; meaning not established from the bytes alone.

fields.name: command
fields.description: Operation selector. Names correlate the opcodes with action_journal.csv.
